item.text: The shared `iterateWithIdleTimeout` implementation is the common path for the provider first-event and post-progress idle watchdogs. It currently calls `setTimeout` with both the initial watchdog delay and each recalculated remaining delay, so I’ll cap both there and cover the boundary with a focused regression test; this also protects `createWatchdog`, which uses the same timeout semantics.
